model.name: roomFolder.createThroughSingleOwner
model.description: The add-room-folder handler creates the room's physical folder by DELEGATING to the ONE physical-folder owner (FolderService.createPhysicalFolder / RoomFilesService, which gates room-physical at server.ts:47), replacing the raw inline fsSync.mkdirSync(target) at server.ts:2565. On fix, server.ts:2565 leaves the INFRA_ALLOW list — green by routing, not by listing.
model.note: Rides the EXISTING owner (FolderService.createPhysicalFolder / RoomFilesService:47) — architect wires Class/Method to the existing owner on build-go if the chain is wanted; no new Method/Impl otherwise.
